title: Maple Blondies
changes_from_base: Maple syrup sweetens a creamed brown sugar batter; no chocolate or nuts.
summary: Soft brown sugar blondies sweetened with pure maple syrup.
equipment: 23 cm square metal baking tin, lined with a baking-paper sling
electric hand whisk or wooden spoon

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Prepare
steps.text: Set the oven to 180 °C (160 °C fan), line the square tin, and whisk the flour, salt and baking powder in a small bowl.

steps.title: Cream
steps.text: Beat the butter and brown sugar into a thick paste, then beat in the egg, maple syrup and vanilla until smooth.

steps.title: Combine
steps.text: Stir in the dry ingredients until just combined; the batter is soft.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Spread in the tin and bake 25-30 min, until the top is golden and a skewer comes out with only a few crumbs.

steps.title: Cool
steps.text: Cool fully in the tin and cut into 16.

tips: Use pure maple syrup, not pancake syrup.
Dark, robust maple syrup gives the strongest flavour.
Do not overbake; they firm up as they cool.
Don't taste the raw dough or batter: raw flour and raw egg aren't safe to eat until baked.
storage: Store airtight at room temperature for up to 4 days, or freeze for up to 2 months.
